fullPassage:
Notice to Hilltop Apartment Residents
In accordance with fire safety regulations, it is essential to keep all hallways free of personal belongings such as bicycles, boxes, and small furniture. Hallways serve as critical evacuation routes during emergencies, and anything left there could block the way and pose serious safety risks. To ensure the safety of all residents, we request that any personal items placed in the hallways be removed by Monday, April 14th. Please note that not following this may result in penalties. We appreciate your cooperation in maintaining a safe environment.

questions.passage: In accordance with fire safety regulations, it is essential to keep all hallways free of personal belongings. Hallways serve as critical evacuation routes, and anything ①[<u>left</u> / <u>leaving</u>] there could block the way.
questions.stem: ①의 괄호 안에서 어법에 맞는 표현을 고르시오.

det.korean: ① left: anything과 leave는 수동 관계이므로 과거분사 left가 적절.
det.analysis:
✅ ① left
❌ ② leaving
❌ ③ 위 내용에서 확인할 수 없다
❌ ④ 본문과 부분적으로만 일치한다
✅ ① left: anything left there = 그곳에 놓여진 모든 것 (과거분사/수동)
❌ leaving: 능동 의미로 부적절 — 물건이 스스로 놓이는 것이 아님
det.tip: 과거분사의 후치수식: anything left = 놓여진 모든 것

questions.passage: We request that any personal items placed in the hallways ①<u>be removed</u> by Monday. Please note that not ②<u>followed</u> this may result in penalties. We appreciate your cooperation in ③<u>maintaining</u> a safe ④<u>environment</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② followed → following: not 뒤에 주어 역할을 하는 동명사(-ing)가 필요.
det.analysis:
✅ ① be removed: request that + (should) be p.p. 적절
❌ ② followed → following: not following this = 이것을 따르지 않는 것 (동명사 주어)
✅ ③ maintaining: in + 동명사 적절
✅ ④ environment: 명사 적절
det.tip: 동명사 주어: V-ing + may/can/will → Following rules is important.

questions.passage: In accordance with fire safety regulations, it is essential ①<u>keeping</u> all hallways free of personal belongings. Hallways ②<u>serve</u> as critical evacuation routes during emergencies. To ensure the safety of all residents, we request that items ③<u>be removed</u> by Monday. We appreciate your ④<u>cooperation</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① keeping → to keep: 'it is essential to V' 구문에서 to부정사가 와야 한다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① keeping → to keep: it is essential to V (가주어 it, 진주어 to V)
✅ ② serve: 복수 주어 Hallways + serve 수일치 적절
✅ ③ be removed: request that + (should) be p.p. 적절
✅ ④ cooperation: 명사 적절
det.tip: it is essential/important/necessary to V — 가주어 it + 진주어 to부정사

questions.passage: In accordance with fire safety regulations, it is essential to keep all hallways free of personal belongings. Hallways serve as ①<u>critical</u> evacuation routes during emergencies, and anything left there could ②<u>block</u> the way. To ensure the safety of all residents, we request that items be ③<u>installed</u> by Monday. We ④<u>appreciate</u> your cooperation.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③ installed(설치된) → removed(제거된): 물품을 '설치'가 아니라 '제거'해야 한다는 맥락.
det.analysis:
✅ ① critical(중요한): 원문 일치
✅ ② block(막다): 원문 일치
❌ ③ installed(설치된): 원문은 removed(제거된) — 반의어
✅ ④ appreciate(감사하다): 원문 일치
det.tip: remove(제거하다) ↔ install(설치하다)

questions.passage: In accordance with fire safety regulations, it is ①<u>essential</u> to keep all hallways free of personal belongings. Anything left there could block the way and pose serious safety risks. Not following this may result in ②<u>penalties</u>. We ③<u>condemn</u> your cooperation in ④<u>maintaining</u> a safe environment.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③ condemn(비난하다) → appreciate(감사하다): 협조에 '비난'이 아니라 '감사'한다는 맥락.
det.analysis:
✅ ① essential(필수적인): 원문 일치
✅ ② penalties(벌칙): 원문 일치
❌ ③ condemn(비난하다): 원문은 appreciate(감사하다) — 반의어
✅ ④ maintaining(유지하는): 원문 일치
det.tip: appreciate(감사하다) ↔ condemn(비난하다)
